Basque.comms_internal: This entry contains a reversed transtive pattern, which is the only regular way to convey the necessary meaning with two overt NPs. “alaitu” is a near synonym used in the same way. A further alternative is “poz hartu” [joy take], but it is normally used as a monovalent predicate (the use of the Y argument in the motivative is commented upon as grammatical but unnatural “eskutzitz-a-gatik письмо-sg-mot”. A still another non-verbal option is to “poz-ik egon” [joy-part be].

CV. The valency pattern could have been influenced by Spanish (“estar contento” used in combination with the preposition “con”). A still further alternative is “poz eman” [joy give] used in the DAT_ERG pattern.
